name: Sorted Set Scheduler and Timing Wheel
description: Implement the dharma-weighted priority queue using sorted sets. Implement the due-time wheel for timed obligations. Replace all setTimeout/setInterval/cron with the centralized scheduler. Add ZRANGEBYSCORE polling and ZINCRBY priority adjustments. This lane is blocked from claiming kernel completion until durable ACK binding is done — scheduler promotion must use durable-first: PGlite write before Valkey enqueue.
